modalities.evidence: tissue regions from the tumor invasive front
We have used CODEX to image 56 proteins simultaneously

output.population: 140 tissue regions from the tumor invasive front of 35 advanced-stage colorectal cancer (CRC) patients, selected from an initial cohort of 715 CRC patients
output.summary: Multiplexed CODEX protein imaging of tissue regions from the tumor invasive front of advanced-stage colorectal cancer patients, split between Crohn's-like reaction and diffuse inflammatory infiltration groups matched for age, sex and tumor characteristics.
